identity.description: Drafts the front matter of a research grant proposal from a research idea: TITLE, BACKGROUND, RELATED WORK (with [n] citations from the corpus via multi-hop retrieval), PROPOSED CONTRIBUTION, and RISKS & OPEN QUESTIONS. Returns a structured draft.json artifact. Premium-priced ($0.10) for the multi-hop research + synthesis work.

inputs.description: A research question about the brain-technology corpus (citations returned as [n])
inputs.example: What are the best EEG motor-imagery decoding methods?

outputs.description: The agent’s answer, citing corpus papers as [n]
Cited papers as structured JSON (title, year, arXiv URL)
Structured draft as JSON: idea, cited papers, and parsed sections (title + body per section)

_default.description: Answer text streamed token-by-token as it is generated
